newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl Mohave coal unit down to Monday.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl Mohave coal unit down to Monday.

text.p: A 790 megawatt (MW) unit at the Mohave coal-fired power plant near Laughlin, Nev., tripped off line just after 1000 MDT on Wednesday, said Edison Intl's Southern California Edison Co, the plant's owner and operator.
The unit is expected to be out of service until Monday for repairs to a boiler tube leak, a company source said.
Mohave's other 790 MW unit continues to operate at a reduced capacity of 620 MW due to smokestack emission limitations, he added.
